{target}

Read the `busa-lead-funnel` skill in this folder, then show the sanitized fund profile and current scoring criteria — the ideal store-count band, ideal monthly-revenue band, and category risk tiers. Never expose secret values.

agentPrompts.label: Update the scoring criteria
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-lead-funnel` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then update the scoring criteria I give you — ideal store-count band, ideal monthly-revenue band, or category risk tiers. Scores are never stored; they recompute live on every read, so this change applies to every lead immediately.
